en.title: MAR 6.2.2 heading refers to 'MAR 8.2.2 (Obligation to draw up insider lists)'; MAR has no chapter 8
en.summary: The heading of MAR 6.2.2 reads 'Reporting Entity is responsible for complying with MAR 8.2.2 (Obligation to draw up insider lists)'. MAR ends with chapter 7 and Schedules 1-4; the obligation to draw up insider lists is MAR 6.2.1. The number has been wrong since the initial version (2017) and is repeated in the table of contents and on the regulator's site.
en.correction: Please replace "MAR 8.2.2" with "MAR 6.2.1" in the heading of MAR 6.2.2. This is an editorial correction under section 19(3)(a) of the AIFC Regulations on AIFC Acts. The table of contents is not part of the act and can be updated at the same time.
